summary: Nothing has earned a promotion this week. The macro-fit backtest failed again (stocks with a macro tailwind did slightly worse, not better), and the forward log now has 249 settled ideas but only 11 dates, well short of the 20 dates a fair test needs, so every agent layer stays information only. This week's settled ideas lost about 3.6% vs SPY on average as the market weakened into the Nov 4 thrust; the old swing Top 2 picks held up better than the average candidate, mostly thanks to two big CDNA wins.
findings: Macro fit (backtest, 6,369 signals Apr 2025-Oct 2026): tailwind +0.61% vs headwind +1.23% over 5 sessions, t -0.46, both halves negative - not proven, stays info only.
Forward log: 249 settled ideas over 11 dates (Oct 15-29); 117 settled this week over 5 dates, avg -3.6% vs SPY. Under 20 dates: too thin to judge any agent layer.
By role (5-session vs SPY): pick1 -0.1% (n 11), pick2 +4.5% (n 11), watch +4.1% (n 41), candidates -2.6% (n 186). Small samples; no conclusion.
Catalyst positive -0.4% vs not -2.1% (t 0.31, halves disagree); red flags absent -2.3% vs present +0.4% (t -0.93); earnings in hold +0.9% vs -0.4% (t -0.35): all not proven.

Macro tailwind (forward) t -0.08; more supporting layers (3+) -4.1% (n 7) vs +0.9% (t -1.07, both halves negative but tiny n); macro brief was never 'low risk' (158 high-risk rows) so it can't be tested yet.

Swing Top 2 scoreboard: 28 closed, avg +1.0% a trade vs avg candidate -1.8%, 43% winners, 57% stopped. This week 9 closed: +2.8% avg vs candidates -7.0% (CDNA +28% and +23%; the other 7 small losses).

Setup review flag is on: breadth thrust Nov 4 (post-thrust playbook favours Rotation Rookie +0.41R, Round Number +0.29R, Leader Pullback +0.24R), Minervini VCP slumping -0.26R over 70 signals, all top-5 themes new since Oct 11.
proposals: No changes yet: not enough data. No layer PASSED; forward evidence covers 11 dates (need 20+). Keep every agent layer and macro fit as information only.
Not a ranking change, just a reminder: the existing setup review flag is up (Nov 4 thrust, VCP slump, new leading themes). If you want, say 'review my trade setups' to look at it.
Next real check: about 3 more weeks of settled rows (roughly Nov 27) gets the forward log past 20 dates.
